lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical lines are visible on the primary torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with wider gaps of approximately 10-15% of torso length in the mid-section, narrowing to ~5% in the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the last two posterior lines are truncated, failing to reach the dorsal ridge or the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the mid-to-lower haunch, with a secondary single spot located lower on the hind limb above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper haunch align horizontally to form a short geometric segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate trajectory; horns emerge at a roughly 45-degree angle from the frontal bone, curving outward and then spiraling inward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.1 times the combined width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes, two white spots on the lower mandible area, and a dark, shaggy ventral fringe extending from the throat to the lower abdomen.
